title: Time check and the question about being an NEA Jazz Master
summary: Kimery reminds them of the flight and asks Baker to put the question on the importance of the NEA Jazz Masters honor.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing the interview: thanks, goodbyes and tape running out

blocks.x: No, no, no, no. I don’t want you to miss your flight. I know that you have food there too, but if we could ask the one question with . . .
. . . this is [?]. NEA, being a Jazz Master.
Oh, you mean about the value of it.
That leads – we’ve already really been there, but basically, just have you comment on the importance, if you think it is important, of being an NEA master – of what they’re trying to do.
